column1: # Work RAM that differs on ours and on Beetle Saturn at the same tick, and why: FIRST, LAST (inclusive), the
# evidence. Read by bomberman lab memory.

column3: The BIOS's vectors, interrupt dispatcher and work area. The core's vectors point at the BIOS's dispatcher (060008xx), which saves registers and calls the game's handler; ours fills the table with the runtime's own entries at VBlank 0 and dispatches interrupts itself.
BIOS code its boot leaves (it sets the cache and calls the BIOS ROM at 00002650). Ours boots without the BIOS and leaves zeros.

Frames above the stack pointer every idle task block saved (060BCB94), where the core's frames hold PCs inside krnl_longjmp (060061E6 to 060061F4), as an interrupt that arrives there pushes them. Ours switches tasks on host fibers (saturn-recomp's tasks.cpp).
clock_copy and the copy after it. The core's clock is the host's (the copy holds the day the run was made); ours starts at run.CLOCK.

Handlers the game keeps to put back later: SYS_GETUINT's answers at 060FC050 and SYS_GETSINT's at 060FC05C, three each (KRNL 060A5408 and the call after it). The BIOS answers with addresses in its own area (0600083C, 0600087C); the runtime answers with its own (0x2000 and 0x1000 plus the vector times 4), which it takes back when the game calls or restores them.

The scheduler's state: 0600603C, a flag KRNL 060074E8 sets and KRNL 06069646 clears every VBlank, and 06006040 and 06006044, which KRNL 06006C00 fills from the chosen task's block (+20 and +28) at every switch. A snapshot finds them at another point of the VBlank on each.
The idle task's count of its rounds (KRNL 060062A0: yield, add one, test a flag, go round), which goes up as often as the CPU has time to spare.

The sprite sort's 500 buckets (060FBFA4 points here), each a head and a tail node index. KRNL 060AA50C appends a node and reads a tail only when the head is set; KRNL 060AA57C walks the buckets and sets every head back to FFFF. So between sorts every head is FFFF on both and the tails, which differ when an earlier frame filled a bucket in another order, go unread.
